forecast_error.title: Forecast error by lock and jornada (a graded run; latest by default)
forecast_error.sql:
SELECT from_j, jornada, ahead, n, round(rmse, 3) AS rmse, round(bias, 3) AS bias,
       round(top50, 2) AS top50_scored, flagged_n, round(flagged_rmse, 3) AS flagged_rmse,
       round(flagged_bias, 3) AS flagged_bias
FROM grade_error WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AND (nullif(:ahead, '') IS NULL OR ahead = :ahead)
ORDER BY from_j, jornada

forecast_error_by_ahead.title: Forecast error by how far ahead: mean of each jornada's error; flagged players pooled
forecast_error_by_ahead.sql:
SELECT ahead, count(*) AS forecasts, round(avg(rmse), 3) AS rmse,
       sum(flagged_n) AS flagged_n,
       round(sqrt(sum(flagged_rmse * flagged_rmse * flagged_n) / sum(flagged_n)), 3) AS flagged_rmse,
       round(sum(flagged_bias * flagged_n) / sum(flagged_n), 3) AS flagged_bias
FROM grade_error WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) GROUP BY ahead ORDER BY ahead

persistence.title: Persistent share of a player's expectation (what PERSISTENT_SHARE is measured by)
persistence.sql:
SELECT persistent_share FROM persistence_by_run
WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast))

decisions_graded.title: Replayed boards: each funnel outcome's forecast against what happened
decisions_graded.sql:
SELECT reached, kind, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN pred / jornadas END), 2) AS forecast_per_jornada,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN real / jornadas END), 2) AS happened_per_jornada,
       round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN real > 0 END)) AS happened_up_pct,
       round(100 * avg(chance)) AS forecast_chance_pct,
       round(avg(value_pred), 2) AS value_forecast_m, round(avg(value_real), 2) AS value_happened_m
FROM grade_decisions WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_decisions))
GROUP BY reached, kind
ORDER BY CASE reached WHEN 'plan' THEN 0 WHEN 'cleared' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, kind

plan_moves_graded.title: Every move a replayed board planned, against what happened
plan_moves_graded.sql:
SELECT lock, move, round(pred, 1) AS forecast, round(real, 1) AS happened, jornadas,
       round(value_pred, 1) AS value_forecast_m, round(value_real, 1) AS value_happened_m
FROM grade_decisions WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_decisions)) AND reached = 'plan' ORDER BY ord

compare_grades.title: Two graded runs' next-jornada forecasts, on the players both forecast
compare_grades.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT a.from_j, a.jornada, a.player, a.predicted AS pa, b.predicted AS pb, a.actual
           FROM grade_forecast a JOIN grade_forecast b USING (from_j, jornada, player)
           WHERE a.run_id = :a AND b.run_id = :b AND a.from_j = a.jornada),
     r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pa DESC, player) AS ra,
                     row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pb DESC, player) AS rb FROM p)
SELECT jornada, count(*) AS n,
       round(sqrt(avg((pa - actual) * (pa - actual))), 3) AS rmse_a,
       round(sqrt(avg((pb - actual) * (pb - actual))), 3) AS rmse_b,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN ra <= 50 THEN actual END), 2) AS top50_a,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN rb <= 50 THEN actual END), 2) AS top50_b
FROM r GROUP BY jornada ORDER BY jornada

timings.title: Runs: seconds by stage, rows parsed, memory
timings.sql:
SELECT r.run_id, r.started, r.trigger, r.commit_sha, r.ok, round(r.peak_mb) AS peak_mb,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'parse' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS parse_s,
       max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'parse' AND m.measure = 'snapshots' THEN m.value END) AS snapshots,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'crosswalk' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS crosswalk_s,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'sim' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS sim_s,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'grade' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS grade_s
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN run_measures m USING (run_id)
GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY r.run_id DESC LIMIT 100

funnel.title: Every move the latest board ranked: gain, confidence, verdict, plan
funnel.sql:
SELECT rank, label, round(gain, 1) AS gain, round(100 * p_better) AS better_pct,
       round(per_million, 2) AS per_million, round(cost / 1e6, 2) AS cost_m, verdict, in_plan
FROM funnel WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM funnel))
  AND (nullif(:name, '') IS NULL OR label LIKE '%' || :name || '%') ORDER BY rank

why_sell.title: Why these sales: every sale of yours ranked by points lost per million raised; the plan takes the cheapest that clear the debt (a balance below zero at the lock scores nothing)
why_sell.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM sim_runs)) AS run_id),
me AS (SELECT max(0.0, -cash) AS debt FROM sim_standings JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE me),
s AS (SELECT f.rank, substr(f.label, 6) AS player, f.proceeds AS raises, f.gain, f.per_million, f.in_plan
      FROM funnel f JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE f.kind = 'sell')
SELECT player, round((SELECT debt FROM me) / 1e6, 1) AS debt_m, round(raises / 1e6, 1) AS raises_m,
       round(gain, 1) AS season_points, round(per_million, 2) AS points_per_m,
       round(sum(raises) OVER w / 1e6, 1) AS raised_so_far_m,
       round(max(0.0, (SELECT debt FROM me) - sum(raises) OVER w) / 1e6, 1) AS debt_left_m,
       (SELECT debt FROM me) > 0 AND raises >= (SELECT debt FROM me) AS covers_alone, in_plan
FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY per_million DESC, rank) ORDER BY per_million DESC, rank

forecast.title: A player's forecast, factor by factor (latest run)
forecast.sql:
SELECT f.jornada, p.name, round(f.ppm, 2) AS ppm, round(f.fixture, 2) AS fixture,
       round(f.picked, 2) AS picked, round(f.fit, 2) AS fit, round(f.points, 2) AS points,
       round(f.plays, 2) AS plays, round(f.expected, 2) AS expected
FROM forecast f JOIN names p USING (player)
WHERE f.run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM forecast))
  AND p.name LIKE '%' || coalesce(:name, '') || '%' ORDER BY p.name, f.jornada

cash.title: Each manager's cash: yours from the app, rivals' from the ledger (as of now)
cash.sql: SELECT manager, round(cash / 1e6, 2) AS cash_m FROM cash ORDER BY cash DESC

ledger.title: The league's money moves, oldest first; inferred = an exit the feed never recorded
ledger.sql:
SELECT l.at, l.kind, l.who, l.other, coalesce(p.name, l.player) AS player,
       round(l.amount / 1e6, 2) AS amount_m, l.buyer, l.seller, l.inferred
FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = l.player
WHERE nullif(:manager, '') IS NULL OR :manager IN (l.who, l.other)
ORDER BY l.at

price_paid.title: What each owner paid for his players (last buy or clause to him)
price_paid.sql:
SELECT o.manager, coalesce(p.name, o.player) AS player, round(pp.paid / 1e6, 2) AS paid_m
FROM owners o LEFT JOIN price_paid pp USING (player)
LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = o.player
ORDER BY o.manager, pp.paid DESC

price_forecast_error.title: Momentum's price forecasts, refitted each day on what was known then, against what happened (mean abs error, % of value; zero = 'no change')
price_forecast_error.sql:
WITH days AS (SELECT day, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY day) - 1 AS r, count(*) OVER () AS m
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT day FROM price_series WHERE observed_at <= (SELECT cut()))),
daily AS (SELECT h, end_day, sum(x * y) AS sxy, sum(x * x) AS sxx FROM momentum_pairs
          GROUP BY h, end_day),
fit AS (SELECT d.day, p.h, sum(p.sxy) / sum(p.sxx) AS slope
        FROM days d JOIN daily p ON p.end_day <= d.day WHERE d.r >= d.m / 4
        GROUP BY d.day, p.h HAVING sum(p.sxx) <> 0),
pred AS (SELECT f.h, f.slope * x.x AS p, x.change AS act
         FROM fit f JOIN price_ahead x ON x.day = f.day AND x.h = f.h
         WHERE f.h IN (1, 3, 5) AND x.end_at <= (SELECT cut()))
SELECT h, count(*) AS n, round(avg(abs(p - act)), 2) AS mae, round(avg(abs(act)), 2) AS zero
FROM pred GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

momentum.title: Price momentum: the slope per horizon and the share of a trend made after each update
momentum.sql: SELECT m.h, round(m.slope, 4) AS slope, round(c.carry, 3) AS carry FROM momentum m LEFT JOIN price_carry c USING (h) ORDER BY m.h

price_trend.title: Each player's expected value change over the horizon, in %
price_trend.sql:
SELECT coalesce(p.name, t.ff_id) AS player, round(t.trend, 1) AS trend_pct FROM price_trend t
LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = t.ff_id
ORDER BY t.trend DESC

price_change.title: Each player's value change in % over :h updates after his last one on or before :day (all time: what happened)
price_change.sql:
SELECT a.ff_id, coalesce(x.change, 0.0) AS change
FROM (SELECT ff_id, max(i) AS i FROM price_series WHERE day <= :day GROUP BY ff_id) a
LEFT JOIN price_ahead x ON x.ff_id = a.ff_id AND x.i = a.i AND x.h = CAST(:h AS INTEGER)

grade_due.title: The code a run is (its commit) and what the last grade before it was made with
grade_due.sql:
SELECT (SELECT commit_sha FROM runs WHERE run_id = CAST(:run AS INTEGER)) AS commit_now,
       r.commit_sha AS commit_graded, m.value AS resolved_graded
FROM (SELECT 1) LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = (
    SELECT max(g.run_id) FROM runs g JOIN run_measures gm USING (run_id)
    WHERE gm.stage = 'grade' AND gm.measure = 'resolved' AND g.ok = 1
      AND g.run_id < CAST(:run AS INTEGER))
LEFT JOIN run_measures m ON m.run_id = r.run_id AND m.stage = 'grade' AND m.measure = 'resolved'

unmatched_players.title: Players the crosswalk cannot join, the dearest first: with no app id he is never seen as owned, priced or bid on; with no line-up page he has no start odds
unmatched_players.sql:
SELECT c.name, f.owner, round(f.value / 1e6, 2) AS value_m,
       CASE WHEN c.app_id = '' AND c.ff_slug = '' THEN 'neither'
            WHEN c.app_id = '' THEN 'no app id' ELSE 'no line-up page' END AS missing
FROM crosswalk c LEFT JOIN player_facts f ON f.player = c.player_id
WHERE c.app_id = '' OR c.ff_slug = ''
ORDER BY f.value IS NULL, f.value DESC, c.name

constants_vs_measured.title: The constants that have an outcome to be measured against, beside it (latest graded run): PERSISTENT_SHARE against the persistence of the forecast's misses, CONFIDENCE against how often a move that cleared the bar then gained
constants_vs_measured.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AS run_id),
c AS (SELECT name, value FROM constants)
SELECT 'PERSISTENT_SHARE' AS constant, (SELECT value FROM c WHERE name = 'PERSISTENT_SHARE') AS set_to,
       (SELECT persistent_share FROM persistence_by_run JOIN r USING (run_id)) AS measured,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT player) FROM grade_forecast JOIN r USING (run_id)) AS n,
       'share of a player''s miss that repeats the next jornada' AS reading
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CONFIDENCE', (SELECT value FROM c WHERE name = 'CONFIDENCE'),
       round(avg(real > 0), 3), count(*),
       'share of moves that cleared the bar (in the plan or not) that then gained'
FROM grade_decisions JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE reached IN ('plan', 'cleared')

bench_points.title: Each finished jornada: the points your fielded eleven scored (the app's line-up at the lock), what sat on your bench, and the best benched player
bench_points.sql:
WITH l AS (SELECT jornada, lock FROM round_locks WHERE jornada IN (SELECT jornada FROM scored)),
fs AS (SELECT DISTINCT observed_at FROM api_lineup),
fa AS (SELECT l.jornada, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM fs WHERE observed_at <= l.lock) AS at FROM l),
ts AS (SELECT DISTINCT observed_at FROM api_teams),
ta AS (SELECT l.jornada, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM ts WHERE observed_at <= l.lock) AS at FROM l),
fielded AS (SELECT DISTINCT fa.jornada, a.player FROM fa
            JOIN api_lineup t ON t.observed_at = fa.at JOIN app_player a ON a.app_id = t.player_id),
squad AS (SELECT DISTINCT ta.jornada, a.player FROM ta
          JOIN api_teams t ON t.observed_at = ta.at AND t.manager = (SELECT me FROM league_config)
          JOIN app_player a ON a.app_id = t.player_id),
pts AS (SELECT player, jornada, sum(pts) AS pts FROM scored GROUP BY player, jornada),
rows AS (SELECT s.jornada, s.player, f.player IS NOT NULL AS in_xi, coalesce(p.pts, 0.0) AS pts
         FROM squad s LEFT JOIN fielded f ON f.jornada = s.jornada AND f.player = s.player
         LEFT JOIN pts p ON p.jornada = s.jornada AND p.player = s.player
         WHERE s.jornada IN (SELECT jornada FROM pts)),
best AS (SELECT jornada, player, pts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pts DESC, player) AS n
         FROM rows WHERE NOT in_xi)
SELECT r.jornada, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.in_xi THEN r.pts END), 0) AS fielded_pts,
       round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN NOT r.in_xi THEN r.pts END), 0), 0) AS bench_pts,
       sum(r.in_xi) AS fielded, n.name AS best_benched, b.pts AS best_benched_pts
FROM rows r LEFT JOIN best b ON b.jornada = r.jornada AND b.n = 1 LEFT JOIN names n ON n.player = b.player
GROUP BY r.jornada ORDER BY r.jornada

rivals.title: Each manager as of the last run: points, simulated finish and the chance he ends above you, cash, squad and its value, and what he did in the last 7 days
rivals.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT run_id FROM sim_runs ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1),
v AS (SELECT o.manager, count(*) AS players, total(f.value) AS value
      FROM owners o LEFT JOIN sim_facts f ON f.player = o.player AND f.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM r)
      GROUP BY o.manager),
since AS (SELECT julianday(substr(cut(), 1, 10) || 'T' || substr(cut(), 12, 2) || ':' || substr(cut(), 14, 2) || 'Z') - 7 AS t),
a AS (SELECT buyer AS manager, count(*) AS buys, total(amount) AS spent, 0 AS sells, 0.0 AS got
      FROM ledger WHERE kind IN ('buy', 'clause') AND julianday(at) > (SELECT t FROM since) GROUP BY buyer
      UNION ALL SELECT seller, 0, 0.0, count(*), total(amount)
      FROM ledger WHERE kind IN ('sell', 'clause') AND julianday(at) > (SELECT t FROM since) GROUP BY seller)
SELECT s.manager, s.me, round(s.now) AS points, round(s.mean) AS season_mean, round(s.finish, 2) AS finish,
       round(100 * s.p_above) AS pct_above_you, round(s.cash / 1e6, 1) AS cash_m,
       coalesce(v.players, 0) AS players, round(coalesce(v.value, 0) / 1e6, 1) AS squad_value_m,
       coalesce((SELECT sum(buys) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) AS buys_7d,
       coalesce((SELECT sum(sells) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) AS sells_7d,
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum(got - spent) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) / 1e6, 1) AS net_m_7d
FROM sim_standings s JOIN r USING (run_id) LEFT JOIN v ON v.manager = s.manager
ORDER BY s.mean DESC
